_comment: Fei recruitment dialogue for There Will Be Kobolds. Fei is a bookish ex-Imperial mage found hiding from soldiers. Her death in battle triggers Iris's berserk mode — seeded here via her observation about Iris's intensity. Dialogue engine reads nodes in sequence; 'choices' branches to node IDs.

fei_intro_01.speaker: Fei
fei_intro_01.text: Oh! Oh, you are not— you do not have the crest. Good. That is very good. Sorry. I have been in here for approximately four hours and I have not established whether the structural integrity of the west beam is—

fei_intro_02.speaker: Fei
fei_intro_02.text: Yes. Yes, my legs are functional. I just — the rubble shifted when I tried to move the larger piece and I ran the probability of secondary collapse and decided that stationary was the safer— yes. I can walk.

kella_02.speaker: Kella
kella_02.text: Then walk. We need to be out of this street before their next patrol.

fei_stance_01.speaker: Fei
fei_stance_01.text: Your stance suggests self-taught — the weight distribution is unconventional but remarkably efficient. Did you develop the footwork independently or was there a period of formal—

fei_iris_observation.speaker: Fei
fei_iris_observation.text: The tall one — with the white hair. She has been watching me since you pulled me out. With an intensity I find both flattering and alarming. Is she... always like that?

kella_iris_answer.speaker: Kella
kella_iris_answer.text: Iris is protective. Don't read into it.

fei_academy_01.speaker: Fei
fei_academy_01.text: I left the Imperial Mage Academy two seasons ago. The curriculum became... politically motivated. They stopped teaching the theoretical basis for containment spells and started teaching us how to identify blight-sympathizers in civilian populations. I decided my education would be better pursued independently.

fei_blight_worry.speaker: Fei
fei_blight_worry.text: The blight worries me more than the soldiers, honestly. The theoretical implications of what it is doing to the ley lines — I have been trying to model it, but I lack sufficient field data. The rate of propagation alone suggests something is actively— sorry. You did not ask.

choices.text: Tell me more about the blight. What have you figured out?
We could use someone who understands magic. Come with us.

branch_magic_01.speaker: Fei
branch_magic_01.text: Oh. You actually want to know. Alright. The blight is not decaying the ley lines — it is rerouting them. Like someone is trying to build a new infrastructure on top of the old one, except they do not know what they are doing, or they do not care about the damage. Either possibility is deeply troubling.

branch_magic_03.speaker: Fei
branch_magic_03.text: Theoretically? Yes. Practically? I would need access to one of the source points. And someone to keep things from killing me while I work. I am competent in combat applications of thaumic theory, but I am considerably better at not being killed when someone else is handling the violence.

branch_accept_01.speaker: Fei
branch_accept_01.text: I— yes. Yes, I would like that. I have been managing alone for two months and I will be honest with you, the loneliness has been nearly as dangerous as the soldiers. I talk to my notes. They have stopped being good conversationalists.

branch_merge_join.speaker: Fei
branch_merge_join.text: I want to help. I know I do not look like much in a fight. But I am very good at staying alive when properly motivated, and understanding the blight is the most important problem anyone could be working on right now. I would like to be useful.

kella_final.speaker: Kella
kella_final.text: Good. Stay close, don't get stepped on, and try to save the theoretical implications for after the stabbing.

fei_final.speaker: Fei
fei_final.text: I can do that. Probably. I make no guarantees about the commentary.
